content.text:
## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
- [Scoped] `claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md`'s `Necessary` section gains a bullet not accounted for anywhere in the body: "Name a change in a line and leave its detail to the diff, which the reviewer can open; spelling out what an added rule, definition, or table row says is detail, whether quoted, summarized, or given with its consequence." This is new normative text (no counterpart in `git show b9256e4:claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md`, the base the body cites as `main`) — it adds "table row" as a new banned-paraphrase category and closes a loophole ("given with its consequence") that base text never addressed. The body's Key changes section enumerates exactly five new-rule additions (Decidable's two, plus the "three rules that licensed unbounded prose are bounded"), and this sixth addition is absent from that list and from the "Where a reformat can change a rule" section, even though the Verification checkbox on the clause mapping explicitly flags that "rules this branch adds are new text ... outside what the mapping checks" without naming this one.

### Note
None.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] "Clause mapping ... covering the 37 rule bullets the reformat carried over" — the record backing this count lives at `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, which is gitignored and confirmed absent from the PR diff/tree, so the exact count can't be reproduced from a clone. The author's own footnote acknowledges this ("checkable on the authoring machine but not from a clone").

### Property walk
- Decidable: Purpose states intent and prior gap, Key changes leads with the most consequential rule changes, reads top-down.
- Grounded: All reproducible claims checked out — base file has 45 top-level bullets/0 nested (confirmed), it is the largest flat list among the 17 markdown files under `claude/rules/` and `claude/skills/` at `b9256e4` (confirmed by counting all 17), the two "restored" Grounded rules carry the same requirement as base (confirmed), and the property-list/template blocks are byte-identical to base (confirmed); one derived count is Unverifiable per above.
- Necessary: No diff paraphrase in the body; bullets are distinct and non-restating.
- Scoped: One hunk in `pr-guidelines.md` (the new Necessary sub-bullet on paraphrase-with-consequence) sits outside the intent the body states — see Fix above.
- Conformant: Title is a one-line summary; checkboxes are used correctly (all `[x]`, author-verified); no auto-close keywords; no hard-wrap violations found in the body under the stated parser.

### Verdict
NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT

tool_input.command:
cd /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles
files=$(git ls-tree -r --name-only b9256e4 -- claude/rules claude/skills | grep '\.md$')
echo "$files" | wc -l
for f in $files; do
  top=$(git show b9256e4:"$f" | grep -c '^- ')
  nested=$(git show b9256e4:"$f" | grep -c '^ \+- ')
  echo "$top $nested $f"
done | sort -rn

gh pr view 370 --json body -q .body > /tmp/pr370_body.md
wc -l /tmp/pr370_body.md
cat -A /tmp/pr370_body.md | grep -n '\$$' | awk -F: '{print $1}' | head -5
awk 'NF{print NR": "$0; next} {print NR": [blank]"}' /tmp/pr370_body.md | head -80
